definitions.explanation: A family unit or household, especially in the context of managing daily life, finances, and domestic affairs. Often carries the nuance of the practical side of running a home.

examples.japanese: {所帯|しょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Having a household increases your responsibilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{所帯|しょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}った→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He started a family at a young age.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{所帯|しょたい}じみた⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: That person has started talking about nothing but domestic matters.

notes:
USAGE:
{所帯|しょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ is a set phrase meaning to start a household or get married and settle down. The word focuses on the practical, everyday side of family life rather than the emotional bonds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所帯|しょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to start a household; to settle down)
- {所帯|しょたい}じみた (domestic-looking; frumpy)
- {所帯|しょたい}{持|も}ち (a person with a family to support)
- {大所帯|おおじょたい} (a large group or household)

NOTE ON READING:
The word {大所帯|おおじょたい} uses the voiced reading じょたい rather than しょたい.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧: household — more administrative and statistical; used on official forms and in census data
- ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧: home; family — emphasizes the warm, nurturing aspect of home life
